policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento amplio disponible en el lote del granero.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Ample parking available in the barn lot.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono.

categories.nameEs: Cortes de Carne y Platos Principales

products.nameEs: Totopos y Salsa Casera de la Casa
products.descriptionEs: Nuestra famosa salsa fresca y crujientes totopos de maíz recién hechos. Una de las mejores de la región.
products.descriptionEn: Our famous signature fresh salsa served with warm, crispy corn tortilla chips. One of the best around.

products.descriptionEs: Queso melted al horno con auténtico chorizo mexicano, servido con tortillas de harina calientes.
products.descriptionEn: Melted cheese baked with authentic Mexican chorizo, served piping hot with warm flour tortillas.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas crujientes bañadas en nuestra salsa picante especial de la casa, acompañadas de aderezo ranch y apio.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our special house spicy sauce, served with ranch dressing and celery sticks.
Classic slow-roasted prime rib cooked to absolute perfection, served with au jus and a baked potato.
Juicy New York strip steak grilled to your liking with exceptional marbling and rich, robust flavor.
Tender and delicate filet mignon, optionally wrapped in bacon, served with seasonal vegetables.
Grilled steak and chicken strips sizzling with peppers and onions. Served with guacamole, sour cream, and warm tortillas.
Three shredded chicken enchiladas smothered in homemade red salsa, melted cheese, and fresh crema on top.
Massive burrito stuffed with tender carnitas, black beans, Mexican rice, pico de gallo, and warm cheese sauce.
Three crispy battered fish tacos topped with purple cabbage, chipotle crema, and fresh cilantro on corn tortillas.
Our signature margarita crafted with 100% blue agave tequila, Cointreau, and fresh lime juice.

products.nameEs: Margarita de Frutos Rojos y Jalapeño
products.descriptionEn: A vibrant blend of tequila, fresh muddled strawberries, spicy jalapeño kick, and a chili-salt rim.

products.descriptionEs: Aguacates Hass madurados en su punto, picados con cebolla, cilantro, tomate fresco y un toque de chile serrano.
products.descriptionEn: Ripe Hass avocados hand-mashed with diced onions, cilantro, fresh tomatoes, and a touch of serrano pepper.

products.descriptionEs: Chiles jalapeños frescos rellenos de queso crema y chorizo artesanal, envueltos en tocino crujiente.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh jalapeño peppers stuffed with cream cheese and artisan chorizo, wrapped in crispy bacon.

products.descriptionEs: Tortillas de maíz enrolladas con pollo desmenuzado, fritas hasta quedar doradas, servidas con crema y salsa verde.
products.descriptionEn: Corn tortillas rolled with shredded chicken, fried golden brown, served with Mexican crema and green salsa.

products.descriptionEs: Camarones marinados en jugo de limón fresco con tomate, cebolla morada, pepino, aguacate y cilantro.
products.descriptionEn: Shrimp cured in fresh lime juice with tomato, red onion, cucumber, avocado, and cilantro.

products.nameEs: Ribeye Steak a la Parrilla (16 oz)
products.descriptionEs: Corte grueso de ribeye marmolado a la parrilla al punto deseado, acompañado de papas asadas y verduras.
products.descriptionEn: Thick-cut, well-marbled ribeye grilled to your preference, served with roasted potatoes and seasonal vegetables.

products.descriptionEs: Fina arrachera asada a la parrilla, acompañada de una enchilada de mole, guacamole, frijoles negros y arroz.
products.descriptionEn: Thinly sliced grilled skirt steak, served with a mole enchilada, guacamole, black beans, and Mexican rice.

products.descriptionEs: Costillas de cerdo tiernas bañadas en salsa BBQ casera con un toque ahumado, papas fritas y elote asado.
products.descriptionEn: Tender pork ribs glazed in house-made smoky BBQ sauce, served with french fries and street corn.

products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo jugosa a la parrilla con glaseado de chile chipotle y miel, servida con arroz cilantro-limón.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy grilled chicken breast with a honey-chipotle glaze, served with cilantro-lime rice and vegetables.

products.descriptionEs: Carne de res, pollo, chorizo, queso fresco y nopales asados servidos hirviendo en un molcajete de piedra volcánica.
products.descriptionEn: Steak, chicken, chorizo, queso fresco, and grilled cactus served sizzling in a traditional volcanic stone bowl.

products.descriptionEs: Cerdo estofado lentamente y dorado al punto, servido en tortillas de maíz con cebolla, cilantro y salsa verde.
products.descriptionEn: Slow-braised pork carnitas crisped to perfection, served on corn tortillas with onions, cilantro, and green salsa.

products.descriptionEs: Camarones salteados en una salsa picante de chiles de árbol y guajillo, servidos con arroz y tortillas calientes.
products.descriptionEn: Shrimp sautéed in a fiery sauce made from arbol and guajillo chiles, served with rice and warm tortillas.

products.descriptionEs: Tequila 100% de agave, puré de mango fresco, licor de naranja y un toque sutil de infusión de chile habanero.
products.descriptionEn: 100% agave tequila, fresh mango puree, orange liqueur, and a subtle infusion of habanero chili.

products.descriptionEs: Bebida tradicional mexicana a base de arroz, leche, vainilla y un toque de canela espolvoreada.
products.descriptionEn: Traditional Mexican refreshing drink made from rice, milk, vanilla, and a dusting of cinnamon.

products.descriptionEs: Selección de cervezas mexicanas de importación servidas bien frías con su respectivo limón y borde con sal.
products.descriptionEn: Selection of premium imported Mexican beers served ice cold with a lime and salted rim.

products.descriptionEs: Refresco mexicano clásico endulzado con azúcar de caña natural con auténtico sabor a toronja.
products.descriptionEn: Classic Mexican soda sweetened with natural cane sugar with authentic grapefruit flavor.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, tenemos varias opciones marcadas en nuestro menú de carnes y antojitos mexicanos. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we feature several marked options across our steak and Mexican menus. Please ask your server.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large parties?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con amplias áreas para grupos grandes. Recomendamos llamar con anticipación al (860) 429-1900, especialmente los fines de semana.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we have large party areas to accommodate groups. We recommend calling ahead at (860) 429-1900, especially on weekends.

faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con un amplio estacionamiento gratuito junto al histórico edificio del granero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer ample complimentary parking right next to our historic converted barn building.
